text_markup: The Runner's {term:memory limit} is the total amount of [MU] the Runner has. If the Runner's identity card does not specify a starting memory limit, their starting memory limit is 4[MU]. An ability of the form "+N[MU]" increases the Runner's memory limit by N[MU].
text_plain: The Runner's memory limit is the total amount of {MU} the Runner has. If the Runner's identity card does not specify a starting memory limit, their starting memory limit is 4{MU}. An ability of the form "+N{MU}" increases the Runner's memory limit by N{MU}.

examples.text_markup: The Runner is playing an identity with a starting memory limit of 4[MU]. They have an installed copy of {card:T400 Memory Diamond}, which has the ability "+1[MU]". The Runner can therefore have up to 5[MU] worth of programs installed.
examples.text_plain: The Runner is playing an identity with a starting memory limit of 4{MU}. They have an installed copy of T400 Memory Diamond, which has the ability "+1{MU}". The Runner can therefore have up to 5{MU} worth of programs installed.
